question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing sweeper, Claire is playing left back, Dave is playing center midfielder, Eve is playing fullback, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Fred trade positions. Then, Alice and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Bob and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) sweeper
(C) left back
(D) center midfielder
(E) fullback
(F) benchwarmer
(G) right winger
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: striker, sweeper, left back, center midfielder, fullback, benchwarmer, right winger
1. Eve ↔ Claire: striker, sweeper, fullback, center midfielder, left back, benchwarmer, right winger
2. Alice ↔ Claire: fullback, sweeper, striker, center midfielder, left back, benchwarmer, right winger
3. Eve ↔ Dave: fullback, sweeper, striker, left back, center midfielder, benchwarmer, right winger
4. Gertrude ↔ Fred: fullback, sweeper, striker, left back, center midfielder, right winger, benchwarmer
5. Alice ↔ Gertrude: benchwarmer, sweeper, striker, left back, center midfielder, right winger, fullback
6. Eve ↔ Gertrude: benchwarmer, sweeper, striker, left back, fullback, right winger, center midfielder
7. Bob ↔ Alice: sweeper, benchwarmer, striker, left back, fullback, right winger, center midfielder
Gertrude plays center midfielder, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
